# Aggregate

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Aggregate point data into polygons (count, sum, mean, min, max per zone).
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/aggregate",
  "type": "AggregateOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/aggregate').par.polygons` (an input) and `op('/aggregate').out.featureCollection` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.polygons`, `out.featureCollection`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `polygons` | `GeoJsonField` | `{"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[]}` |
| `points` | `GeoJsonField` | `{"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[]}` |
| `field` | `StringField` | `""` |
| `operation` | `StringLiteralField` | `"count"` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:end outputs -->
